scene_identity: steps is the physical scene (one fixed indoor atrium); each bag is a distinct scene_sequence
area_source: estimated from the occupancy-grid union because every recording uses the same fixed indoor scene-global coordinate frame
excluded_recordings_reason: atrium_20260824_120001 is the calibration bag reserved for tracking validation; converted for provenance but excluded from every split.

heading_provenance.meaning: Measured body/camera orientation, which can differ from direction of travel.
heading_provenance.source: the tracking system's Kalman-posterior body yaw over ground (`tracked_people[].yaw_ground_rad`), not derived from converted positions.

cleaned_source.note: Tracks pre-filtered by the upstream cleanup pass before conversion; see each recording's cleanup.report.json.
cleaned_source.comparability: min_speed=0.35 removes stationary and slow pedestrian tracks upstream, so density and interaction statistics describe the cleaned tracks only.
